_doc: Room randomizer settings. A 'room' is a biome. The mapping is a permutation of biomes as DESTINATIONS:
every door that would lead to D now leads to map[D]. A biome keeps its own exits and everything inside it.

Requirements live on the DOORS and never move: they are physical obstacles on the exit (abilities, Boss Cells, boss defeated...). The only exception is the biome unlock item, a constraint added by the mod on the destination biome: it follows the biome the door really leads to.
fixed: biomes that never move (the start). Biomes without depth (Bank, BossRush, Challenge) never move either:
the Bank is not part of the graph, it replaces a level at random.
boss_tiers: tiers used by the Tier mode: the boss arenas of each tier are shuffled together. NOT the boss rush tiers:
Dracula (DookuArena) is tier 3 here, and the Collector (Observatory) is a tier 3 boss.
groups: optional overrides {biome id: group 1..3} for Tier mode. By default a normal biome belongs to the group delimited by
the boss tiers around its depth (before the tier 1 bosses = 1, between tier 1 and 2 = 2, between tier 2 and 3 = 3).
Astrolab (depth 9, after every tier boss) is put in group 3 so that it can move in Tier mode.
